The opinion frames the case as interpreting Miranda after a suspect indicates he wishes to remain silent, so the Miranda Waiver and Invocation home is supported.
The opinion refines Miranda by rejecting a per se bar on renewed questioning and adopting the scrupulously honored standard.
Lake progeny fields report 1649 indexed citing opinions and citation_count 2562, supporting the Key role characterization.
residual_risks: No separate home page file was disclosed, so only the role's fit to this case and lake record was checked.

defect.evidence_quote: We therefore conclude that the admissibility of statements obtained after the person in custody has decided to remain silent depends under Miranda on whether his "right to cut off questioning" was "scrupulously honored."
defect.problem: The holding is directionally supported but overbroad as written: the opinion holds that admission did not violate Miranda's right-to-silence principles, not that later statements are admissible for all purposes whenever the invocation was scrupulously honored. The holding field is also visibly truncated at 'here,…'.
defect.proposed_fix: Narrow to: After a suspect invokes the right to remain silent, renewed questioning and later statements are not barred by Miranda's right-to-silence rule if police scrupulously honor the suspect's right to cut off questioning; in Mosley, questioning stopped immediately, resumed only after a significant interval and fresh warnings, and concerned a different crime.

reasons: The quoted phrase scrupulously honored appears in the opinion and the rule is supported at 423 U.S. 104.
The support is limited by the opinion's own wording: admissibility depends under Miranda on whether the right to cut off questioning was scrupulously honored.
The opinion later states only that admission did not violate Miranda and remands, so the bare phrase 'later statements are admissible' should be narrowed.
residual_risks: Other suppression grounds were mentioned in the opinion but not resolved by this holding.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Replace 'invocation' with 'right to cut off questioning' and add 'under Miranda' to prevent all-purpose admissibility overclaim.
